dedupe_keys.name: irish hydrometric reference network daily observed and infilled flows version 2

description: Maynooth University publishes version 2 of the Irish Hydrometric Reference Network daily river-flow dataset. It covers 51 high-quality gauging stations in the Republic of Ireland, from each station’s own record commencement through 2022. Six public text files separate observed flows, modelled flows, infilled flows, station metadata and the 2.5 and 97.5 percent uncertainty bounds. GR4J and a backpropagation neural network, driven by catchment precipitation and temperature, generated flows used to fill observation gaps. Zenodo provides the release free under CC-BY-4.0. It can calibrate catchment models, test hydrological extremes and supply inflow histories for water-resource simulations. These companion observed and infilled products allow modellers to retain the distinction between measurement and reconstruction. Network stations were selected using observations, gauge metadata and trend checks, so the sample is not every Irish river. Station start dates and individual gaps require the supplied metadata; the files and modelling performance were not independently tested.
